source: Li and Watts, The orientation-preserving diffeomorphism group of S2 deforms to SO(3) smoothly, arXiv0912.2877v2
actual_full_reading_extent: Full §3 PDF/printed pp12–16, including definition E/F/H, Lemma3.2, Theorem3.3, Lemma3.5 and proof3.1. Intro pp1–3 read; proof2.7ff only partially read and not used. No claim of a full16-page proof reading.
consumed_interface: Relative-square smooth isotopy construction for one fixed orientation-preserving diffeomorphism equal to identity near its boundary.
local_replacements: Global smooth complex argument constructed by a closed one-form primitive on the convex square.
The source Poincare–Bendixson step discharged by the actually read published local generalized PB supplier and the actually read Hopf turning theorem plus smooth Jordan disk.
An explicit speed density using the compact exit-time range supplies the endpoint-derivative-one reparametrization; no global functional choice of epsilon or Sobolev input is used.
The right-boundary correction is written explicitly as a positive convex interpolation of interval diffeomorphisms.
